text: This is on the 3rd floor of the brand new Bangmod Aesthetic Hospital. So new it's not on Google Maps yet. So make sure to tell your driver its' about 50mtrs down on the left from the old hospital, well sign posted. Lovely facilities and kind and helpful staff. The dentist explains every step of the process and does very professional work. I went for a scale and clean but this will be my clinic in BKK going forward.
